# Balance mod: the game's file, copied whole, with only the colony window's
# building lock added to each type's can_destroy (balance_building_not_kept).
# Generated by write_building_locks.py -- rerun it after every game update.
early_council_hall = {
	audio_tier = 1
	is_foreign = no
	max_levels = 1
	pop_type = burghers

	employment_size = generic_burgher_employment

	category = government_category
	forbidden_for_estates = yes

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes

	expensive = yes

	build_time = government_build_time

	unique_production_methods = {
		early_council_hall_maintenance = {
			paper = 0.25
			fine_cloth = 0.05
			books = 0.05
			category = building_maintenance
		}
	}


	construction_demand = town_building_construction

	modifier = {
		local_max_control = 0.025
		local_crown_estate_power = 0.10
	}

	can_destroy = { balance_building_not_kept = yes  # Balance mod: colony window building lock
	}
}

			paper = 0.5

			books = 0.1
			category = building_maintenance
		}
	}

	obsolete = early_council_hall

		local_max_control = 0.05

	can_destroy = { balance_building_not_kept = yes  # Balance mod: colony window building lock
	}
}
